policies.title: Non-exempt ordinary passports: advance visitor visa
policies.summary: None of these ordinary-passport nationalities appears in the current Visa Exemption Order 2023 schedule. Kiribati Immigration expressly requires non-exempt visitors to apply in advance.
conditions: The Order applies its named nationality waiver to ordinary/normal, official/service, and diplomatic ICAO-compliant passports or travel documents. None of this residual ordinary-passport cohort is named, so no listed-document waiver is carried into this baseline; it does not establish special-document treatment.
The current Immigration page requires a passport valid at least six months beyond departure, confirmed onward or return travel, and evidence of sufficient funds.

Visitor-visa processing is an advance route: download the Visitor Visa Application Form, email it with scanned documents to visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki, then follow the visa officer's payment instructions. It is not an eVisa or an unrestricted visa on arrival.

application.label: Kiribati Visitor Visa application instructions
steps: Download the official Visitor Visa Application Form from the Immigration Division resources.
Email the completed form and scanned supporting documents to visaofficer@mfa.gov.ki.
Follow the visa officer's instructions for secure electronic payment before travel.
